context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for expiration date validation in Supplies form is fully working. Both HTML5 min attribute (tomorrow's date) and JS validation (expirationDate <= today rejected) are enforced. Frontend routes: /supplies. Modal opened via 'Nouvel approvisionnement' button.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: 'Date Périmé le' field allowed past dates. Fix (Supplies.js lines 254-266 & 1017-1022) adds: (1) JS check in handleAddItem() that rejects dates <= today with french toast error, (2) HTML min attribute set to tomorrow's ISO date to prevent visual selection of past/current dates in native date picker. Both layers verified working.
